items.quote: the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend
items.claim: The LORD spoke directly to Moses in face-to-face conversation
items.mechanism: face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend

items.quote: he turned again into the camp
his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle
items.claim: Joshua, son of Nun, remained in the tabernacle and did not depart
